title: frametrail:attributes of type "mastodon"
description: Mastodon post. The src is the post's URL. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items (and the attributes of resources) whose type is "mastodon". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

html.description: Embed HTML from the instance's oEmbed answer. Used instead of an iframe when present.

embedUrl.description: URL of the post's embed page. Missing means src + "/embed".

instance.description: Host name of the Mastodon instance.
